title: Wheelchair access to scenic overlooks and state trails
summary: In August 2026 a testifier asked the disability commission for short, paved paths so wheelchair users can reach scenic overlooks, and the topic could go on a later agenda. In September a commissioner said the commission had not yet acted on the request about accessible state trails.

timeline.text: A commissioner said there was no commission action yet on a request about accessible state trails.
